lab_declaration: 本任务属于 aetfq3-lab / Lab，不属于 V2.1 Stable。
boundary_statement: Lab-only public intraday no-label tensor validation; no labels required, no supervised learning, no QMT, no OrderIntent, no Stable effect.
phase: F public intraday no-label tensor-shape validation

input_type.source: AKShare stock_zh_a_minute / Sina public minute data

validation_steps: validate required columns: trade_date, datetime, etf_code, open, high, low, close, volume, amount
compute vwap from amount / volume when vwap is absent, with safe handling for volume=0
compute no-label feature columns: open, high, low, close, volume, amount, vwap, intraday_return, return_from_open, distance_to_vwap
block forbidden feature columns: future_*, *_label, max_drawdown_3d, execution_return_to_close, execution_return_to_next_open, execution_drawdown_after_entry
validate tensor shape [batch, time_steps, features] with min_time_steps >= 12 and feature_count > 0
next_steps: Use this validator only as a public OHLCV no-label tensor shape gate.
If supervised training is requested later, require real labels or future outcomes and run a separate dry validation.
If a real provider is requested later, require an independent safe provider file and rerun F-7 first.
